summary: Dedicated: sporadic upstream timeouts tied to per-tenant rate limiter
description:
Issue summary:
- VertexLedger embeddings endpoint sometimes times out instead of returning 429.

Impact:
- Client sees long hang then timeout; their retry logic amplifies load.
- Occurs during bursts; not correlated with GPU saturation.

Primary symptom: Request timeouts
Deployment offering: Dedicated

Notes:
- Investigation suggests rate limiter path is blocking on Redis call and not failing fast.
comments: Grace Oconnor (2026-03-18): Escalating because customer can’t distinguish timeouts vs capacity issues.
Rishi Malhotra (2026-03-18): Confirmed: limiter waits on Redis p99 ~2s and can cascade under burst.
Rishi Malhotra (2026-03-18): Patched: fail-open to 429 when Redis exceeds 200ms + add circuit breaker.
Grace Oconnor (2026-03-19): Customer confirms timeouts are gone; now sees clean 429s.
